story.text: 거제 바닷가 캠핑장, 해가 지자 선우가 장작을 이리저리 쌓으며 능숙하게 불을 피운다. "이 정도는 눈 감고도 한다, 내가."
story.reading: geo-je ba-dat-ga kaem-ping-jang, hae-ga ji-ja seon-u-ga jang-jag-eul i-ri-jeo-ri ssah-eu-myeo neung-suk-ha-ge bul-eul pi-un-da. i jeong-do-neun nun gam-go-do han-da, nae-ga.
story.en: At a seaside campsite in Geoje, as the sun sets, Sunwoo skillfully stacks firewood this way and that, building a fire. "I could do this much with my eyes closed."

story.text: 장작이 타닥타닥 소리를 내며 타오르자 주황빛 불빛이 얼굴에 어른거린다. 선우는 만족스러운 표정으로 모닥불 앞에 자리를 잡는다.
story.reading: jang-jag-i ta-dak-ta-dak so-ri-reul nae-myeo ta-o-reu-ja ju-hwang-bit bul-bit-i eol-gul-e eo-reun-geo-rin-da. seon-u-neun man-jok-seu-reo-un pyo-jeong-eu-ro mo-dak-bul ap-e ja-ri-reul jab-neun-da.
story.en: As the firewood crackles and blazes up, an orange glow flickers over our faces. Sunwoo settles in front of the campfire, looking pleased with himself.

story.text: "이게 요즘 말로 '불멍'이다. 아무 생각 없이 불만 보는 거." 그가 나뭇가지로 장작을 뒤적이며 새로운 말을 알려준다.
story.reading: i-ge yo-jeum mal-lo bul-meong-i-da. a-mu saeng-gak eop-si bul-man bo-neun geo. geu-ga na-mut-ga-ji-ro jang-jag-eul dwi-jeog-i-myeo sae-ro-un mal-eul al-lyeo-jun-da.
story.en: "This is what people call 'bul-meong' these days. Just staring at the fire without any thoughts." He explains the new expression while poking at the firewood with a stick.

story.text: 말없이 한참을 불만 바라본다. 신기하게도 마음이 놓이는 게, 굳이 무슨 말을 하지 않아도 편안하다.
story.reading: mal-eop-si han-cham-eul bul-man ba-ra-bon-da. sin-gi-ha-ge-do ma-eum-i noh-i-neun ge, gud-i mu-seun mal-eul ha-ji anh-a-do pyeon-an-ha-da.
story.en: We stare at the fire in silence for a good while. Strangely, my mind settles at ease — comfortable even without any need to say a word.

story.text: 하늘을 올려다보니 별똥별 하나가 순식간에 스쳐 지나간다. "빨리 소원 빌어라!" 선우가 다급하게 내 옆구리를 찌른다.
story.reading: ha-neul-eul ol-lyeo-da-bo-ni byeol-ttong-byeol ha-na-ga sun-sik-gan-e seu-chyeo ji-na-gan-da. ppal-li so-won bil-eo-ra! seon-u-ga da-geup-ha-ge nae yeop-gu-ri-reul jji-reun-da.
story.en: Looking up at the sky, a single shooting star streaks by in an instant. "Quick, make a wish!" Sunwoo nudges my side urgently.

story.text: "무슨 소원 빌었노?" "비밀이다." 그가 장난스럽게 눈을 흘기더니, 이내 다시 잔잔한 미소로 불씨를 바라본다.
story.reading: mu-seun so-won bil-eot-no? bi-mil-i-da. geu-ga jang-nan-seu-reop-ge nun-eul heul-gi-deo-ni, i-nae da-si jan-jan-han mi-so-ro bul-ssi-reul ba-ra-bon-da.
story.en: "What did you wish for?" "It's a secret." He shoots me a playful glare, then soon goes back to gazing at the embers with a quiet smile.

story.text: 장작이 다 타들어갈 때까지 우리는 그 자리를 지켰다. 말보다 침묵이 더 많은 걸 전하는 밤이었다.
story.reading: jang-jag-i da ta-deul-eo-gal ttae-kka-ji u-ri-neun geu ja-ri-reul ji-kyeot-da. mal-bo-da chim-muk-i deo man-eun geol jeon-ha-neun bam-i-eot-da.
story.en: We held our spot until the last of the firewood had burned down. It was a night where silence said more than words ever could.

words.example_en: He stacked firewood and lit a campfire.
We sat gathered around the campfire.

words.meaning: zoning out while staring blankly at a fire (slang)
words.example_en: Staring blankly at the fire at the campsite put my mind at ease.
Hearing his voice put my mind at ease.
I saw a shooting star in the night sky.

sentences.en: He gathered firewood and started a fire.
Sitting in front of the campfire, my heart grew warm.
These days, many people have staring at fires as a hobby.

sentences.ko: 친구 말을 듣고 나서야 마음이 놓였다.
sentences.reading: chin-gu mal-eul deut-go na-seo-ya ma-eum-i noh-yeot-da
sentences.en: Only after hearing my friend's words did I feel at ease.
A shooting star fell across the night sky.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이 정도는 눈 감고도 한다, 내가. 장작 쌓는 거는 내한테 맡기라.
turns.reading: i jeong-do-neun nun gam-go-do han-da, nae-ga. jang-jak ssah-neun geo-neun nae-han-te mat-gi-ra.
turns.en: I could do this much with my eyes closed. Leave the firewood stacking to me.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 완전 능숙하네. 캠핑 자주 오나 보다.
turns.reading: wan-jeon neung-suk-ha-ne. kaem-ping ja-ju o-na bo-da.
turns.en: You're so skilled at this. You must go camping a lot.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 그렇지도, 뭐. 불 피우고 이래 불멍 하는 기 낙이다, 내한테는.
turns.reading: geu-reo-chi-do, mwo. bul pi-u-go i-rae bul-meong ha-neun gi nag-i-da, nae-han-te-neun.
turns.en: I guess so. Lighting the fire and just staring at it like this is my little joy.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: What's 'bul-meong'? I've never heard that word before.

dialogues.question: 선우가 승객에게 알려준 '불멍'의 뜻은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sunwoo explain the word 'bul-meong' means?
dialogues.correct_answer: 아무 생각 없이 불만 멍하니 바라보는 것
options: 아무 생각 없이 불만 멍하니 바라보는 것
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 '불멍'이 아무 생각 없이 불을 멍하니 바라보며 쉬는 것을 뜻하는 요즘 말이라고 알려줍니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 저기 봐라, 별똥별이다! 빨리 소원 빌어라!
turns.reading: jeo-gi bwa-ra, byeol-ttong-byeol-i-da! ppal-li so-won bil-eo-ra!
turns.en: Look over there, a shooting star! Quick, make a wish!

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Huh, where, where! It's already gone.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 그래도 순간적으로 빌었제? 나는 확실히 빌었다.
turns.reading: geu-rae-do sun-gan-jeog-eu-ro bil-eot-je? na-neun hwak-sil-hi bil-eot-da.
turns.en: Still, you managed a quick wish, right? I definitely got mine in.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: What did you wish for? I'm curious too.

dialogues.question: 선우가 별똥별을 보자마자 승객에게 한 말은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sunwoo say to the passenger the moment he saw the shooting star?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 별똥별이 사라지기 전에 얼른 소원을 빌라며 승객을 재촉합니다.
